basic_details.job_title: IIMJ Field Investigator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Jammu (IIMJ) is filling one Field Investigator post for the project "Development of Commercial Economic Corridors for Boosting Jammu & Kashmir's Economic Development to Generate Employment and Revenue", supported by NITI Aayog. The pay is Rs. 20,000 per month plus HRA of Rs. 4,000 per month for 1.5 months. A graduate degree in any relevant discipline with minimum 55% marks is required. Candidates apply through a Google Form by 18 November 2026, 5:00 pm, and attend a walk-in interview on 19 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form link given in the notice (see Important Links).
Fill the form and submit it on or before 18.11.2026 till 5:00 pm.
Report at IIM Jammu Jagti Campus by 9:30 AM on 19.11.2026 for the Walk-In Interview.
Carry all the original documents to the interview.
important_instructions: Candidates must appear for the Walk-In Interview with all the original documents. The selected candidate must be ready to join immediately. The position is purely temporary and project based. Accommodation will not be provided.

rows.details: Development of Commercial Economic Corridors for Boosting Jammu & Kashmir's Economic Development to Generate Employment and Revenue
Rs. 20,000/- per month + HRA of Rs. 4,000/- per month
Indian Institute of Management Jammu, Jagti, Jammu – 181221

content_sections.heading: About IIMJ
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Jammu is located at Jagti, Jammu. This notice, dated 13.11.2026, invites online applications from all eligible candidates for a Field Investigator on a NITI Aayog-supported project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post, Field Investigator, with the following requirements. Education: graduate degree in any relevant discipline from a recognized university/institution with minimum of 55% marks. Experience: experience in statical analysis software (e.g., MS Office and basic data handling /documentation skills), as printed. Preferred: proficiency in written and spoken Dogri/Kashmiri/Hindi languages. Age: upper age limit 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- per month plus HRA of Rs. 4,000/- per month. The notice describes the position as purely temporary and project based, for a total duration of 1.5 months. Accommodation will not be provided.

content_sections.heading: IIMJ Field Investigator Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate is expected to: Conduct literature review, design research studies, and collect data Tabulate and enter data in the relevant software Analyze data Prepare data visualizations and research reports/publications, etc. Support stakeholder mapping and coordination for consultations, interviews and field activities

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMJ Field Investigator
content_sections.text: Open the Google Form link given in the notice (see Important Links). Fill the form and submit it on or before 18.11.2026 till 5:00 pm. Report at IIM Jammu Jagti Campus by 9:30 AM on 19.11.2026 for the Walk-In Interview. Carry all the original documents to the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice names a Walk-In Interview on 19.11.2026 (Thursday), from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Reporting time is 9:30 AM at IIM Jammu Jagti Campus. The decision of the Selection Committee will be final and binding.

content_sections.text: Candidates must appear for the Walk-In Interview with all the original documents. The selected candidate must be ready to join immediately. The position is purely temporary and project based. Accommodation will not be provided.
